name: Personalised UV-printed MDF house name plate, approx. 14x12 in (custom family name)
supplier_cost_note: Pati Graphics, Bhubaneswar (Odisha): 'House Name Plates' Rs 200/piece excl. tax (IndiaMART, seen 2026-10-22); size and material not stated in snippet. Other: Delhi MDF name plate Rs 75-150/piece; Pune 12 in MDF Rs 300/piece. Must confirm 14x12 in MDF, single-piece custom print, drop-ship.
retail_observed: Amazon.in snapshots 2026-10-22: 14x12 in premium 3D UV-printed MDF Rs 799; 40x30 cm MDF family name board Rs 999; customised family name + house number Rs 636; 15x7 in 3D-letter plate (MustHome) Rs 474; small 9x3 in engraved plates Rs 269-299 (smaller, not comparable).

demand_signals.source: Housiey: 10 Home Decor Trends Taking Over Indian Homes in 2026
demand_signals.summary: Seller/realty blog listing woven baskets, brass decor and hand-painted/handmade artisan decor and personalised decor among 2026 Indian home-decor trends (editorial, no volume data)

risks: Supplier size/material at Rs 200 not confirmed; at Rs 300+ it fails at Rs 799
Custom orders: spelling errors become seller cost; need proof-approval step and a 2-4 day lead time
Corner chipping/scratches in transit; 3D acrylic letters can snap
Smaller 15x7 in plates sell from Rs 474, so size must be clearly the larger format
Personalised items are usually non-returnable, but marketplace policy must be checked
GST rate (HSN 4421/4911) to be confirmed by CA

review.notes: Pati Graphics' IndiaMART profile is a general print shop and no house-name-plate listing with size/material could be found, so the Rs 200 cost basis is unverified; other custom wooden plates are Rs 300-500/piece wholesale (Pune Rs 300, Ecozone Rs 500) and break-even at the Rs 799 price ceiling (a like-for-like 14x12 in plate sells at Rs 799) is about Rs 280 (Rs 300 -> 27.6%). Before a sample, get a written quote for 14x12 in MDF UV print, single-piece drop-ship, with a proof-approval step; listing must state personalised items are non-returnable except damage/seller error (seller pays for spelling errors), and packaging must protect corners.
